candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory failing with timeout/DependencyUnavailable, causing POST /v1/reservations 503 and upstream order/checkout transport ReadTimeouts (~2s).
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not observed; root cause of the redis timeout (saturation, network, config) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show a consistent chain: gateway checkout -> order -> inventory -> redis.reserve_inventory timing out, yielding 503 at reservations and 502 at checkout with ~2s durations. Gateway metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2387ms) and 502s. Bounded candidate is redis-timeout; redis-side evidence is still needed to confirm origin.
missing_evidence: Redis/inventory dependency metrics and logs to confirm redis latency/saturation as the origin
Order service logs to confirm it propagates inventory 503 rather than failing independently
